messages:
maria.p: Heads-up — I'm out sick for the afternoon, passing primary to @aj_khan. I'm on phone if needed but will be slow. See coverage notes below.

aj_khan: Acknowledged. I'll take primary from 15:00–23:00 UTC. Devon, can you be secondary and handle paging if anything escalates? :+1:

devon: Yep, I'll be secondary. Quick Q: what do we want to do about partially degraded clusters (5xx < 5% but spikes) — page or monitor?

maria.p: For now: if SLO error ratio > 3% sustained for 5m or spike causing customer-facing latency > 300ms P95, page. If it's isolated 4xx/5xx from a single region and frontend retries, monitor and file a follow-up. If unsure, page.

maria.p: Runbook refs:
- api-prod-error-runbook: https://confluence.redwood/api-prod-error
- pager matrix: https://confluence.redwood/pager-matrix
- runbook snippet to start: 
```
# quick triage
kubectl -n prod logs -l app=api --since=10m | grep ERROR | head
check datadog: query "service:api AND (status:5xx) by region"
```

oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — 5xx spike on api-prod (service:api) — 4.8% errors, p95 latency 410ms, region eu-west-1. Alert ID: INC-20260314-4321

aj_khan: I'm looking. Creating a private bridge: /join bridge-prod-1754321123

devon: I'm jumping on the bridge to watch metrics. If we need to scale, I'll trigger canary autoscale for the eu-west pool.

ops-lead: If bridge shows customer impact > 10% of requests failing or any major checkout flow broken, escalate to SEV2 and page me + infra on-call.

eve: FYI — mobile team reported some errors in crash logs but not widespread. I'm leaving notes in the bridge.

aj_khan: Initial check: no recent deploys in the last 2h. Rolling CPU spike on api-frontend pods. Scaling up 2 replicas now.

maria.p: Perfect. Reminder: paging rules — immediate phone page for SEV1/SEV2 (payment/customer-facing outage). For SEV3, Slack notify and email first, phone only if >15m unresolved.

devon: Scaling applied. Watching for recovery.

oncall-bot: RECOVERY — error rate down to 1.4% after scale up. Monitoring for 10m to confirm. Incident ID INC-20260314-4321 (status: recovering)

aj_khan: Marking the incident as mitigated for now. We'll keep the bridge open 30m for observation. Maria, can you follow up tomorrow on postmortem if you're okay?

maria.p: Yes — I'll own the postmortem. Leave any logs, timestamps, and correlating graphs in the incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260314-4321

devon: Noted. Quick checklist for whoever follows up:
- save flame graphs from 14:55–15:05 UTC
- snapshot autoscale decisions
- confirm no latent errors in mobile crash logs

aj_khan: Thanks team. I'll update the oncall rota to reflect I'm primary. @ops-lead — re: escalation timeout, can we codify the 15m rule into the pager matrix? it's too manual.

ops-lead: Agree. I'll open a ticket to add explicit escalation timers and tie them into our pager policies.

maria.p: Great. One more operational note: if primary is unavailable for >2h, call the secondary and then the manager. We had a gap last week; this should be a hard rule.

devon: A couple of tweaks to runbook I spotted — adding the `kubectl` one-liners and a small checklist for autoscale thresholds. Will push a PR to the runbook page.

aj_khan: Bridge closing in 28m unless we see a regression. Thanks everyone.

oncall-bot: BRIDGE CLOSED — automatic closure scheduled. If new alerts come in, this thread will be re-opened.

maria.p: Thanks all. Leaving my phone reachable. :phone:
